Bug_Explanation: The class CloneableExample implements Cloneable but the clone() method returns Object instead of CloneableExample. This violates the rule that clone()'s return type should match the class name for covariant returns.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test calls the method showBug() which internally calls the clone() method of CloneableExample. The clone() method returns an Object instead of CloneableExample due to the bug. The test attempts to assert that the returned Object is an instance of CloneableExample, which fails, thereby triggering the bug.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that the test passed successfully (OK), which means the assertion did not fail. Therefore, the bug was not triggered during the test execution.
